Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

These instructions are in addition to the previous OMs on the subject, and in no way dilute the responsibility of the deputationist and borrowing departments to ensure that the deputationists are relieved in time on completion of their approved tenures. - Order (8), Section I, Appendix 5.
